memory.content: Do not install, connect, or re-suggest Unusual Whales, Cheddar, or FlowAlgo for this workflow. Same-day options prints use free public sources only: Yahoo, Cboe, Barchart, or other public pages.

Every options report must include: spot and ITM/OTM % per print; IV (or "source has no IV"); expiry groups with gross and net notional (net = after removing deep ITM / hedges / combos); nearest earnings and earnings-week labels; OI vs volume when available (volume >> OI → possible new opens; volume << OI → possible rolls/closes); same-expiry near-size adjacent strikes tagged vertical / possible combo.

After top-10 and sections A–F, always deliver a summary: one line per expiry week — bullish / bearish / neutral / insufficient data — plus 2–4 sentences. Infer only from net structure after stripping deep ITM / hedges / combos; sell call is not bullish; buying deep ITM puts is not bearish; 0DTE is its own week; name earnings weeks; thin or unclear net → insufficient data. Public chain structure only — not tape and not trade advice.
